name: evm-fast
description: Prove RISC-V bytecode equivalent to the fixed Pancake EVM guest in Lean, and minimize the certified execution step bound K. The initial submission claims infinity.
hardware: Official runs: Linux guest with systemd 257+ and Landlock ABI 3+, 16 Lean processes, 112 GiB memory cap per build unit, 8-hour limit per build. The initial submission takes hours to build and writes about 120 GB of build output. Use a case-sensitive file system (paths differ only by case).
